Subject: Follow-up: Security & IAM questions (SOC 2, SSO/SCIM)

Thanks again for taking the call today — great conversation. Per our discovery, I wanted to recap the open items and proposed next steps so we can keep the procurement/security review moving: 

Summary of ask from Finlytics:
- Confirm SOC 2 Type II status and provide most recent report/cert
- Vendor security questionnaire (you mentioned sending one)
- Details for identity & access: SSO (SAML/IdP metadata), SCIM provisioning support and attribute mappings, RBAC/admin controls and audit logging

What Redwood will provide:
- SOC 2 report (or SOC 2 readiness notes if still in progress) and data flow diagram
- Completed vendor security questionnaire (we can pre-fill the security responses)
- SSO documentation: SAML IdP metadata stub and step-by-step SSO guide
- SCIM docs: API endpoints, attribute list, provisioning scope, example payloads
- Screenshots/description of admin roles and RBAC (admin console) and audit log retention policy

Next steps/action items:
1) Samantha / Rajiv: please send over the Vendor Security Questionnaire when convenient (you mentioned an Excel template).
2) Redwood (Monica / Laura): we’ll compile SOC 2 evidence + SSO/SCIM docs and upload to the shared folder. Target: 48 hours.
3) If Finlytics wants a technical deep-dive on SCIM attributes and SAML flows, we can do a 30-min call with our infra/security engineer — proposed slots: Tue 3/2 10–12PT or Wed 3/3 2–4PT.

Attaching for context: none yet — will follow up with attachments from our security team.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security & IAM questions (SOC 2, SSO/SCIM)

Hi Samantha / Rajiv — thanks for the quick turnaround and the questionnaire. I can own the evidence pack and proposed deliverables below.

Deliverables we will provide (by EOD Wed 3/3 unless we escalate):
- SOC2 Type II report (SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf) or SOC2 readiness statement + remediation timeline if the full report is under NDA processes.
- Completed Vendor Security Questionnaire (we will pre-fill technical/security sections and flag items requiring legal sign-off).
- SAML SSO: IdP/SP metadata (SSO_Metadata.xml attached), step-by-step SSO checklist, expected SAML attributes (nameID, email, givenName, familyName) and supported bindings (HTTP-Redirect, HTTP-POST).
- SCIM provisioning: Redwood supports SCIM 2.0 for user and group provisioning. Public docs: https://redwood.app/drive/scim-api-docs. Supported attributes: userName, id, externalId, active, emails, name.givenName, name.familyName, groups (groupName). Group sync: yes (basic group membership sync).
- RBAC & admin controls: export of roles (Org Admin, Team Admin, Billing Admin), screenshots of admin console role assignment, and audit-log export sample (showing user provisioning and admin role changes). Audit logs retained for 90 days by default; extended retention available as an add-on.

If helpful, I can join a 30-minute technical Q&A with Rajiv to walk through SCIM attribute mapping and SSO test steps. Proposed times: Tue 3/2 10:30–11:00PT or Wed 3/3 2:30–3:00PT. Please confirm a slot and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attaching initial artifacts: SSO_Metadata.xml (stub), will upload SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf and screenshots to the shared folder once legal confirms distribution.

Thanks,
Monica Patel

Redwood Inference
